name: Bang Bang Salmon Rice Bowl with Cucumber, Avocado & Cilantro Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch cilantro
1 lime
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place oil and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the spice oil and stir to coat. Transfer salmon to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until salmon is golden and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Add honey and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter half of a cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long sticks; place on a plate. Small dice remaining whole cucumber and add to the bowl with the dressing.

Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Slice half of the avocado lengthwise into wedges, add to the plate with the cucumber sticks, and set aside. Small dice the remaining avocado, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Place mayo, sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, and garlic powder in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the Bang Bang sauce. Set a ¼-cup aside for the kid plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp sweet chili sauce
2 tsp soy sauce
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: When the salmon is done, add 1 cup to the plate with the cucumber and avocado. Drizzle remaining salmon with Bang Bang sauce and sriracha, then gently stir to coat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of rice, a 1/3-cup edamame, reserved cucumber, avocado, and salmon between plates. Serve with reserved Bang Bang sauce for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice, spicy salmon, and edamame between bowls. Top with cucumber-avocado salad and enjoy!
